Figure 1. Phylogenetic analysis of EmES. The corresponding product

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Heterologous expressions of EmES and the structures of
produced sesterterpenes. (A) GC−MS profiles of mycelial extracts
from (i) Aspergillus oryzae transformants expressing EmES (AO-
EmES) and (ii) AO strain as control. (B) HPLC profiles (210 nm) of
mycelial extracts from AO transformants harboring (i) EmES and
EmEP450 (AO-EmES + EmEP450), (ii) EmES (AO-EmES), and (iii)
AO strain as control. (C) Structures of emerindanols A and B.
